headline: Putin arrives in India for BRICS summit coloured by wars
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi ahead of an 11-member BRICS summit, with talks expected with Narendra Modi and Iran's president. Economic challenges are also on the agenda.
why: BRICS is a bloc of major emerging economies that coordinates on trade, payments and energy, so its summits can shape cross-border trade and sanctions dynamics.
